assets.title: Assets Management
assets.description: Define and manage your system assets here.
assets.noAssetsHint: Add assets manually or sync from DFD to get started.
assets.noDFDImageHint: Save the DFD to generate a preview image

C.name: Confidentiality
C.template: {{assetName}} must only be accessible by authorized personnel and systems.

I.name: Integrity
I.template: {{assetName}} must be protected against unauthorized modification. Any change must be detectable.

A.name: Availability
A.template: {{assetName}} must be available to authorized users within defined service levels.

N.name: Non-repudiation
N.template: All operations on {{assetName}} must be traceable and undeniable by the acting party.

AuthZ.name: Authorization
AuthZ.template: Access to {{assetName}} must be restricted based on explicitly defined permissions.

AuthN.name: Authentication
AuthN.description: Verifying identity of users or systems
AuthN.template: The identity of any principal accessing {{assetName}} must be verified before access is granted.

Acc.name: Accountability
Acc.template: All actions on {{assetName}} must be logged with sufficient detail for audit and forensic purposes.

causeMechanism.heading: How could the damage occur?
causeMechanism.subheading: Select all applicable damage causes. The system derives protection requirements automatically.

graphInfo.title: Graph derivation — prerequisites
graphInfo.req1: Asset is linked to at least one DFD element
graphInfo.req2: Element has an asset relation with a known relation type (stores, reads, controls, uses, …)
graphInfo.req3: Asset category is correctly set (Data, System, Infrastructure, …)
graphInfo.fallback: Without DFD links: cause mechanisms can be selected manually.

content_manipulation.label: Content Manipulation
content_manipulation.description: Unauthorized modification of data, parameters, or configuration

unavailability.label: Unavailability / Outage
unavailability.description: Failure or blocking of systems, functions, or data

missing_evidence.label: Missing Evidence
missing_evidence.description: Actions cannot be proven or denied (non-repudiation failure)

missing_accountability.label: Missing Accountability
missing_accountability.description: Actions cannot be attributed to an actor (missing audit trail)

financial_damage.name: Financial Damage
financial_damage.description: Costs from outages, SLA violations, RMA, fines

regulatory_compliance.name: Regulatory / Compliance
regulatory_compliance.description: Violations of GDPR, ISO 27001, FDA, etc.

reputation.name: Reputation / Brand
reputation.description: Loss of customer trust, negative media

affected_users.name: Affected Users / Systems
affected_users.description: How many users, units, machines or systems are affected

recoverability.name: Recoverability
recoverability.description: Effort and time to restore asset after loss or manipulation

safety.name: Safety Impact
safety.description: Risk to persons through physical damage

physical_damage.name: Physical Asset Damage
physical_damage.description: Destruction or damage to physical assets

supply_chain.name: Supply Chain / Logistics
supply_chain.description: Disruption of physical supply and transport chains

validation.noSecurityGoalDescription: Asset {{id}}: security goal {{type}} has no formal description
validation.noPhysicalImpactRationale: Asset {{id}}: manual safety impact requires rationale
validation.notLinkedToDFD: Asset {{id}}: not linked to any DFD element
validation.goalRationaleMissing: Asset {{id}}: security goal {{type}} was decided manually without a rationale

goalOverrideStale.suggestionRemoved: Asset {{id}}: {{type}} is no longer suggested — the basis of the manual decision is gone
goalOverrideStale.suggestionAdded: Asset {{id}}: manually added {{type}} is now also suggested by the graph
goalOverrideStale.levelRaised: Asset {{id}}: suggested level of {{type}} has risen since the manual decision — review
goalOverrideStale.levelLowered: Asset {{id}}: suggested level of {{type}} has fallen since the manual decision (manual choice is now more conservative)
goalOverrideStale.basisChanged: Asset {{id}}: suggestion for {{type}} now rests on a different basis — check whether the rationale still fits

validation.goalUnassessed: Asset {{id}}: {{type}} is suggested, but no impact is rated — rate the asset impact
validation.goalProvisional: Asset {{id}}: level of {{type}} is provisional — the goal-specific impact criteria are not rated yet
validation.goalNoApplicableImpact: Asset {{id}}: {{type}} is suggested, all relevant impact criteria are n/a (minimum level)
validation.goalOverrideExceedsAsset: Asset {{id}}: {{type}} rates {{criterion}} higher than the asset itself — reset the goal value or raise the asset value
validation.goalEnvelopeSlack: Asset {{id}}: no active security goal reaches the asset value for {{criterion}} — intended as a higher worst case?
validation.threatWithoutGoal: Asset {{id}}: {{count}} threat(s) of category {{stride}} ({{threats}}) violate no active security goal — add {{goals}} or check whether the threats belong to this asset
validation.goalWithoutThreat: Asset {{id}}: no threat violates {{type}} — is the goal needed, or is a threat missing?

safetyImpact.title: Safety / Physical Impact
safetyImpact.description: Derived from DFD SafetyAnnotation via graph traversal. Manual override requires rationale.

overallImpact.title: Business Impact
overallImpact.description: Calculated from all configured impact factors.

aggregatedImpact.title: Aggregated Impact
aggregatedImpact.highPlus: Indirect safety relevance + HIGH Business Impact

hva.title: High-Value Asset
hva.description: Derived from impact factors + recoverability (replacementLeadTime, vendorDependency, spareAvailability). Triggers override rules.
hva.critical: CRITICAL — Threat priority forced to CRITICAL
hva.high: HIGH — Threat priority forced to CRITICAL

downstream.title: Downstream Assets
downstream.description: Number of assets depending on this asset (Asset-to-Asset graph, BFS traversal). Higher = more propagation risk.

cianaaa.title: Security Goals (CIANAAA)
cianaaa.description: Derived from impact factors via CIANAAA rules. Manual override possible.

dialog.levelRationalePlaceholder: Why does this protection level differ from the system suggestion?
dialog.consequencePlaceholder: Adverse consequence of compromising this property — e.g. 'location disclosure enables physical stalking'.
dialog.tooManyCriteria: You have selected more than 6 criteria...
dialog.physicalImpactRationaleHint: Required for manual override (IEC 62443-4-1 audit trail)
dialog.physicalImpactRationalePlaceholder: Why does safety impact differ from DFD annotations?
dialog.hvaRationalePlaceholder: Why is this asset difficult to replace?
dialog.securityGoalRequirementsDescription: Define a formal requirement for each active security goal (audit-relevant).
dialog.selectDamageCause: Select at least one damage cause above.

config.title: Asset Impact Configuration
config.info: Select 4-6 impact criteria that are relevant for your project. This configuration affects all assets.
config.conservativeDesc: Uses the highest impact value across all criteria
config.averageDesc: Calculates the average of all impact values
config.roundingCeilDesc: Always rounds up to higher risk level
config.safetyLocked: Safety criterion is locked — graph contains safety annotations
config.mandatoryLocked: Mandatory under the active regulation preset (ISO/SAE 21434 SFOP) — cannot be removed
config.safetyLockedInfo: The "Safety" criterion is locked ON because the DFD contains safety annotations.
config.weightsDisabled: Weights are disabled in Conservative (MAX) mode — switch to Weighted Mean to use them.

dfdPreview.hint: Drag to pan, scroll to zoom

exportImport.assetDataDesc: {{count}} assets with impact ratings and security goals
exportImport.configurationDesc: Impact criteria, scale, and calculation settings
exportImport.exportInfo: Select what you want to export. The file can be imported into another project.

goalCards.heading: Security goals
goalCards.help: Goals are suggested from the asset's DFD relations; their level follows the impact criteria of the goal's violation. Adjust or exclude a suggestion only with a rationale.
goalCards.subheading: The damage potential (tab 1) is the upper bound. Each card shows why the goal applies and what drives its level.
goalCards.empty: No security goal suggested — link the asset to DFD elements or add a goal below.
goalCards.notSuggested: Not suggested by the DFD relations — added manually.
goalCards.rationaleRequired: Required when deviating from the suggestion
goalCards.rateImpactHint: No impact is rated for this asset yet. Rate the impact criteria — the level of this goal follows from them; no rationale is needed. If the asset truly causes no damage, rate the criteria as n/a.
goalCards.noThreatTooltip: No threat violates this goal — is the goal needed, or is a threat missing?

driver.fallback: Provisional: no goal-specific criterion rated, highest is {{criterion}} = {{value}}
driver.notApplicable: No applicable damage — all relevant criteria n/a

staleMsg.suggestionRemoved: This goal is no longer suggested — the basis of this decision is gone.
staleMsg.suggestionAdded: This goal is now also suggested by the DFD relations (suggestion: {{level}}).
staleMsg.levelRaised: The suggested level has risen to {{level}} since this decision — is your level still justified?
staleMsg.levelLowered: The suggested level has fallen to {{level}} since this decision; your choice is now more conservative.
staleMsg.basisChanged: The suggestion ({{level}}) now rests on a different basis — does the rationale still fit?

rationale.adjusted: Why does the suggested level not fit?
rationale.excluded: Why is this security goal not relevant for this asset?
rationale.added: Why is this security goal needed in addition?
rationale.impact: Why does this goal's impact differ from the asset's?

impact.cap: Maximum {{max}} — from the asset's damage potential. If this damage is more severe, raise the asset impact first.

reviewFilter.label: Needs review only ({{count}})
reviewFilter.tooltip: Show only assets with errors or warnings in the findings

goalChips.needsReview: Needs review — see the findings below the table

notifications.title: {{count}} finding(s)
notifications.open: Open the asset where this is fixed
notifications.onlyInfos: No errors or warnings — infos are hidden.
notifications.summary: {{errors}} errors · {{warnings}} warnings · {{infos}} infos — details below the table
